transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I keep not finishing important steps at work. Like I’ll start the sanitation checklist, or the batch logs, or the end-of-line paperwork, and somehow I leave off the last parts. I know it matters and that my job depends on it being done right, but I still keep missing the finish.
Do you feel anxious or worried when you're working on these tasks?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I feel anxious in the moment, at least not that I notice. It’s more like I’m trying to get through the task, and then later I realize I missed something.
Do you have any recurring thoughts that keep coming back to you?
Not really. I mean, I have things on my mind like anyone, but I don’t notice the same thought coming back over and over or getting stuck in my head.
Do you often act on impulse or do things without thinking them through?
I don’t think so, not usually. I mean, I can make mistakes, but I wouldn’t say I’m doing things on impulse or rushing into stuff without thinking.
Do you have any repetitive behaviors that you feel compelled to do?
No, I don’t think so. I don’t really have anything I feel like I have to repeat or do a certain way. At least, nothing that stands out to me.
Do you often find yourself easily distracted while working on tasks?

Yes, definitely. Even when I start my shift trying really hard to focus, after a while the cutting, weighing, and checking labels kind of all blur together. I’ll realize I’ve just been staring at the same tray or the log sheet and not really taking in what I’m supposed to do next.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're sitting still?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’m especially restless when I’m sitting still. I might shift around sometimes, but nothing I’ve really noticed as a big problem.
Do you often have trouble sustaining focus during tasks or activities outside of work?

Yes. It happens outside of work too, where I’ll start something trying to really focus, and then after a while it just kind of slips. I’ll be looking at the same page or the same task and realize I’m not actually taking in what I’m supposed to do next.
Do you often feel guilty about things that happen or things you've done?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think guilt is a big thing for me day to day. I mean, if I make a mistake I’ll feel bad about it, but I haven’t noticed feeling guilty all the time or anything like that.
Do you have trouble organizing your tasks or activities?
I’m not totally sure. I mean, I try to keep things organized, but I don’t know if it’s more than normal. I haven’t really paid close attention to that specifically.
Do you often put off tasks until the last minute?

Yes, I do. Especially with things like certification modules or long procedure reading. I’ll leave them until the last possible minute because sitting there trying to take in all the rules feels almost physically exhausting.
Do you feel anxious when you think about not completing your tasks correctly?

Yes. At work especially, I get really anxious about not doing things right. It’s already gotten to the point where I’ve had formal retraining meetings, and coworkers have had to cover parts of my duties. I worry I’m becoming a safety concern instead of the reliable worker I want to be, and I’m scared I’ll get moved off the line or even fired.
Do you often feel like you're not good enough or that you're a failure?
I’m not sure. I mean, I do get down on myself when I mess things up, but I don’t know if I’d say I often feel like a failure. It’s more like frustration with myself in the moment.
Do you often feel worthless?
Not really, no. I get frustrated with myself and embarrassed when I mess up, but I don’t usually feel worthless.
Do you often worry about things even when there's nothing wrong?
I don’t think so. I mean, I worry when there’s a clear reason, like if something went wrong or I’m expecting consequences, but I don’t usually worry out of nowhere when everything seems fine.
Are your difficulties with completing tasks and focusing interfering with your relationships or daily activities outside of work?

I’m not totally sure. I notice it more when I’m trying to get things done, but outside of that I haven’t really thought about whether it affects relationships much. Daily stuff, maybe sometimes, but I’d have to think about it.
Are your difficulties with tasks and focusing causing problems in your personal relationships?

I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really noticed it causing problems with people close to me, or at least nobody’s said that to me directly. It’s more something I notice when I’m trying to get things done.
Do you often worry about the future?
I don’t think I worry about the future that often. I mean, I think about it sometimes, like anyone would, but it doesn’t feel like I’m constantly worrying about it.
Do you feel anxious or worried most of the time, even when there's no specific reason for it?
No, I wouldn’t say most of the time. I get worried sometimes, but not usually for no reason or all day.
Do you feel anxious or worried for more days than not over the past few months?
I don’t think so. I’ve had anxious moments here and there, but I wouldn’t say it’s been more days than not over the past few months.
